title: CTRES v1.1 R15 Bet Event
description: One bet, round, ticket or hand (§4.15): the Wagering module of §10, optional at every conformance level and required where the profile sets submission.bet_level. The record is emitted when the bet is placed and re-emitted, with op update in a stream (§8.4), when its state changes; in a package only the final state appears, in the file R15_bet_events.jsonl. An R13 line for a period equals the R15 records of that line aggregated under the profile's recognition, placed_at for stakes recognised when placed and settled_at when settled (§4.13; §5 Revenue and levy recognition); that reconciliation belongs to the conformance suite (§11). R15 carries no personal data beyond the pseudonymous player reference (§12).

bet_id.description: Identifier of the bet, round, ticket or hand, stable across its re-emissions (§4.15).

player_ref_scope.description: Brand or licence the player reference belongs to (§4.15; §4.2).

product_line.description: The operator's own product or game-type code, as carried by R13 product_line, so that the bets of a line aggregate to its statement (§4.15; §4.13).

channel.description: Channel the bet was placed through: online, a retail point, or a venue (§4.15; §4.13).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency in which the stake and the winnings are stated (§4.15; §3 Currency-aware).

stake.description: Cash part of the stake (§4.15; §4.13 stakes_cash).

placed_at.description: When the bet was placed or accepted; the anchor of stakes recognised when placed (§4.15; §5 Revenue and levy recognition).

status.description: State of the bet: open, settled, void (the stake returned), or cashed_out (settled early at the operator's offer) (§4.15).

stake_bonus.description: Part of the stake funded from bonus or promotional credits (§4.15; §4.13 stakes_bonus).
stake_bonus.x-ctres-condition: Where part of the stake was funded from bonus or promotional credits (§4.15).

winnings.description: Cash winnings paid or credited at settlement, gross of any withholding tax (§4.15; §4.13 winnings_cash).
winnings.x-ctres-condition: Where status is settled or cashed_out and winnings were paid or credited; absent or zero while status is open (§4.15).

winnings_bonus.description: Winnings credited as non-cashable credits (§4.15; §4.13 winnings_bonus).
winnings_bonus.x-ctres-condition: Where bonus winnings were credited at settlement (§4.15).

settled_at.description: When the bet was settled, voided or cashed out; the anchor of stakes and winnings recognised when settled (§4.15; §5 Revenue and levy recognition).
settled_at.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where status is settled, void or cashed_out; not used while status is open (§4.15).

void_reason.description: Why the bet was voided, for example an event cancelled or a palpable error (§4.15).
void_reason.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where status is void; not used otherwise (§4.15).

jurisdiction_category.description: The category of the profile's product taxonomy that product_line maps to, as on R13 (§4.15; §4.13; §5 Revenue and levy).
jurisdiction_category.x-ctres-condition: Where the profile publishes a product taxonomy (§5 Revenue and levy aggregation taxonomy).

venue_id.description: Venue the bet was placed at, as carried by venue_id on the venue's R1 cash_float location and on the venue line of R13 (§4.15; §4.13; §4.1).
venue_id.x-ctres-condition: Where channel is venue and the licence covers more than one venue, or the profile's aggregation axes include venue (§4.15; §4.13; §5 Revenue and levy aggregation). The licence and the profile are not visible to the record, so this schema does not enforce the condition.

game_ref.description: Identifier of the game, event or market in the operator's platform; never its content (§4.15).

odds.description: Odds offered at placement, as a decimal string in the format the operator quotes (§4.15).

rake_and_fees.description: Commission, rake or fee the operator earned on the bet (§4.15; §4.13 rake_and_fees).

jackpot_contribution.description: Contribution of the bet to a progressive or pooled jackpot (§4.15; §4.13 jackpot_contributions).

ledger_entry_refs.description: Ledger entries of the stake debit and the winnings credit, in the ledger that ledger_entry_ref on R3 and R4 names (§4.15; §4.3).

authority_reference.description: Identifier a central system or hub issued for this bet, where the profile routes bets through one (§4.15; §5 Mandatory hubs and gateways; §4.3 authority_reference).

evidence_ref.description: Where the platform's bet log or record behind this event is retained (§4.15; §7).

winnings.x-ctres-message: winnings is absent or zero while status is open
